The workout

  1. Hack Squat (Heavy)1 × 4–6
  2. Hack Squat (Back-Off)1 × 8–10
  3. Incline DB Press2 × 8–10
  4. Seated Hamstring Curl1 × 10–12
  5. T-Bar Row2 × 10–12
  6. DB Bicep Curl1 × 12–15 (dropset)
